KIRTI SINGH, J.(Oral)
This common judgment shall decide the aforementioned two petitions as the petitioner filed these petitions under Article 226/227 of the Constitution of India for issuance of direction to respondent-State to ensure that he be protected from high handedness, inhumane torture which are being meted out by the administration of Jail authorities.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that when CRWP No.10721 of 2022 was filed, the petitioner was lodged in District Jail Roopnagar, Punjab and thereafter he was shifted to various Jails as he was under trial in different cases in the State of Punjab. Presently, the petitioner is lodged in Central Jail Bathinda and preferred the CRWP-3440-2024. He | attest to the accuracy and integrity of this document KAPIL 2024.08.30 13:48 2084 FHRCIIISS CRWP-3440-2024(O0&M) 2 CRWP-10721-2022(0&M) further submits that petitioner is facing a lot of atrocities, cruelty and hurdles created by the Jail authorities. The petitioner is a diabetic patient and is not getting proper Gaurav Sharma Alias Goru Bacha vs State Of Punjab And Others on 23 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192066273/
1 treatment.
3. Learned State counsel has strongly opposed the petition. He submits that petitioner has been marked as Category-A high risk prisoner based on his bad criminal antecedents. He further refers to reply dated 15.07.2024 and submits that petitioner is currently confined in Central Jail, Bathinda. 
He is involved in multiple crimincal cases of serious nature including cases of murder, attempt to murder, Arms Act, Prisons offences etc. The petitioner has a history of misbehaving with the Jail staff giving threats to jail authorities and he was reprimanded twice and cases of judicial appraisals were sent to the learned District and Sessions Judge, Bathinda for sanctioning the punishment proposed by Superintendent Jail. The petitioner is provided with food, as prescribed in the rules, the facility to use the telephone through a pay phone for 10 minutes every day, facility to purchase approved articles of daily usage from the jail canteen as required. Medical facilities and any other basic amenities as per rules. Apart from these, there is ample time when he is able to meet, mingle,
share company, talk and play with other fellow prisoners confined in the same High Security zone. 
4. He also submits that there has been no discrimination against the petitioner with respect to the facilities made available to him. He further submits that only restriction being applied on him and all inmates lodged in High Security Zones is that they are not allowed to leave the Zone without proper security escort and this has been done for the safety and security of not only the inmates lodges in High Security Zones, but also of the whole jail in general. 
5. Heard the rivals submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and have perused the relevant records. 
| attest to the accuracy and integrity of this document KAPIL 2024.08.30 13:48 2084 FHRCIIISS CRWP-3440-2024(O0&M) 3 CRWP-10721-2022(0&M)
6. The petitioner has history of filing writ petitions against jail officials to pressurize them. Earlier also, the petitioner had filed CRWP-893- 2022 before this Court, in which he alleged that inhuman treatment is given to him. He was transferred to Central Jail Bathinda as part of policy, the petitioner has once again filed this baseless and false petition. The proper medical facilities are being provided to the petitioner as laid down under the law. The Jail Medical Officer is conducting regular check-ups of the petitioner and prescribed medicines are being provided to him. Moreover,
the petitioner is confined along with other co-inmates inside the barrack and is availing all the basic privileges which are allowed to prisoners under the Jail Rules. 
7. The allegations made by the petitioner are baseless and fictitious and are made with mala fide intention. To ensure the overall safety of the State in mind, all the gangster/smugglers/high risk prisoners admitted in Central Jail Bathinda are kept under strict vigil and supervision to curb their notorious activities inside and outside the Jail. 
8. Accordingly, in view of the reply filed by learned State counsel as well as keeping in view the criminal antecedents of the petitioner, no further interference is called for at this stage.
